messages.subject: D-RUG is meeting now: Accessing the Farm!
parts:
Hi all, 

The Davis R Users' Group is meeting now until - noon in the Datalab classroom (Room 360 in Shields Library). And if you can't make it in person, feel free to find us via zoom! 

The first part of D-RUG will be led by Reed who will teach us about accessing Farm, a Linux-based supercomputing cluster for the College of Agricultural and Environmental Sciences, and the second part will be open work time.

Best, 
Your D-RUG Coo[R]dinators
